name: second-brain
description: Auto-captures durable knowledge from Claude sessions (and delegated opencode work) into your knowledge wiki with a background Haiku agent

vaultPath.title: Vault path
vaultPath.description: Absolute path of the folder that holds your knowledge wiki, for example ~/Documents/my-wiki. Leave empty to choose it in the Second brain pane on first run.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model for the gate check and the capture agent

batchTurns.title: Turns per batch
batchTurns.description: Finished turns with a typed prompt before the gate check runs

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: Minutes with no new turn before a partial batch is checked

readRoots.title: Read roots
readRoots.description: Optional. Comma-separated folders the capture agent may read for context besides the vault, for example your code folder. Leave empty to choose in the pane.
